{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for SEVERE disease presence
df_severe = df[df['severity'] == 'severe']

print(f'Number of rows with SEVERE disease: {len(df_severe)}')
print(f'Unique patients with SEVERE disease: {df_severe["patient_id"].nunique()}')

# Check if -999 appears in biomarker_baseline for SEVERE patients
severe_with_neg999 = df_severe[df_severe['biomarker_baseline'] == -999]
print(f'Number of SEVERE patients with -999 in biomarker_baseline: {len(severe_with_neg999)}')"}
